headline: Bitcoin Options Skew Fell to 9.32 From 14.29 Into the Oct. 16 Expiry
narrative: Bitcoin options skew fell to 9.32 from 14.29 into the Oct. 16 expiry, with the 75k put bid against the 90k call, down from the 92k call. The options pipe is the price of downside protection versus upside calls, and the gap narrowed, so less premium is bid for a drop while downside stays heavily bid. Bitcoin changed hands near 81k, down 2.63 percent.
author: jordan
